sort_combined.title: Sort Combined
sort_combined.description: When true, order by sum of |m_i|/max_i over selected metrics in the filtered set (same scale as stacked bars). When false, use sort_by + sort_mode.

metric_max_abs.title: Metric Max Abs
metric_max_abs.description: When combined sort ran: ABS max per metric over the filtered cohort — stacked-bar segment widths use this so they match ranking logic.

LeagueMedianBand.title: LeagueMedianBand
LeagueMedianBand.description: Median squad age-band shares across clubs in one league.

LeagueMinutesOverviewResponse.title: LeagueMinutesOverviewResponse
LeagueMinutesOverviewResponse.description:
League-wide minutes overview: one row per club, with each club's squad
minutes broken down by age band (% of that club's total minutes). Sorted by
youth share descending, tie-broken alphabetically by club.

style_fit.title: Style Fit
style_fit.description: Cosine similarity in z-scored style space (higher = closer fit).

LeagueStyleFitRow.title: LeagueStyleFitRow
LeagueStyleFitRow.description: Cosine similarity of player style vs minutes-weighted league centroid (see legacy League Style Fit).

LeaguesMinutesOverviewResponse.title: LeaguesMinutesOverviewResponse
LeaguesMinutesOverviewResponse.description:
Cross-league overview: one row per league with median zone shares across
its clubs. Sorted by ``sort_by`` band descending, tie-broken alphabetically.

domestic_country.title: Domestic Country
domestic_country.description: Primary domestic passport label for this league (e.g. England).

MinutesDistributionResponse.title: MinutesDistributionResponse
MinutesDistributionResponse.description:
Squad minutes distribution for a single club in a single season.

`max_league_minutes = max_league_games * 90` from the static
`LEAGUE_MAX_GAMES` table in `core/config.py`. Multi-stage / playoff leagues
use the regular-season game count; downstream callers clamp the per-player
pct to 100 in case a player accrues playoff minutes on top.

Age bands are fixed: youth (<23), peak (<29), experienced (<34),
veteran (>=34). `zone_shares` are % of the squad's total minutes played.

minutes_played.title: Minutes Played
minutes_played.description: Season minutes for this row; UI hides PI headline under typical radar threshold.

PerformanceIndexHistoryPoint.title: PerformanceIndexHistoryPoint
PerformanceIndexHistoryPoint.description: Single season snapshot for scout profile PI progression (club = dominant minutes row).

PerformanceIndexHistoryResponse.title: PerformanceIndexHistoryResponse
PerformanceIndexHistoryResponse.description: Chronological (oldest → newest), at most ``limit`` seasons with non-null PI.

passport_countries.title: Passport Countries
passport_countries.description: Passport country in this list (exact match on Wyscout "Passport country" column when present in the view).

performance_index_role_rank.title: Performance Index Role Rank
performance_index_role_rank.description: Rank (1-based) of this player among same-role peers in the percentile cohort.

performance_index_role_cohort_size.title: Performance Index Role Cohort Size
performance_index_role_cohort_size.description: Total players in the same-role percentile cohort (denominator for the rank).

x_tv_eur.title: X Tv Eur
x_tv_eur.description: Expected transfer value (EUR) from the xTV v2 model for the player's season row.

player_image_url.title: Player Image Url
player_image_url.description: HTTPS headshot URL (Transfermarkt CDN or Wyscout image when enriched in parquet)

clubs_in_season.title: Clubs In Season
clubs_in_season.description: All (club, minutes) rows for this wyscout_id in the season — surface a switcher when length > 1.

performance_index_history.title: Performance Index History
performance_index_history.description: Filled when GET /players/{wyscout_id}/profile sets performance_index_history_limit (mini PI trajectory).

x_tv_history.title: X Tv History
x_tv_history.description: Filled when GET /players/{wyscout_id}/profile sets x_tv_history_limit (mini xTV trajectory).

PotentialCohortRequest.title: PotentialCohortRequest
PotentialCohortRequest.description: Single age-cohort slice for the Potential big-board (paginated).

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.description: Optional multi-season set. Empty → filters.season only.

xtv_supported.title: Xtv Supported
xtv_supported.description: False when the club has no xTV-eligible seasons in the response.

foreign_share.title: Foreign Share
foreign_share.description: Share (0-1) of players whose Passport country differs from the modal squad passport.

n_players_500.title: N Players 500
n_players_500.description: Players with at least 500 minutes (quality cohort for PI / xTV z-score).

avg_performance_index.title: Avg Performance Index
avg_performance_index.description: Mean performance_index among players with >= 500 minutes.

squad_xtv_zscore.title: Squad Xtv Zscore
squad_xtv_zscore.description: Z-score of total squad xTV (500+ min cohort) vs league mean.

avg_performance_index.title: Avg Performance Index
avg_performance_index.description: Mean performance_index among players with >= 500 minutes.

squad_xtv_zscore.title: Squad Xtv Zscore
squad_xtv_zscore.description: Z-score of total squad xTV (500+ min cohort) vs league mean.

SquadValueTeamRow.title: SquadValueTeamRow
SquadValueTeamRow.description: Squad-level aggregates for one club in one season.

min_standout_z.title: Min Standout Z
min_standout_z.description: Keep players at least this many σ above the league average.
